name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Jae-hyun's path to motorsport was paved with a relentless pursuit of precision. From a young age, he was fascinated by the intricate workings of machinery, spending countless hours disassembling and reassembling everything from old radios to discarded engines. This passion led him to a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he honed his fabrication skills in the demanding world of shipbuilding. Seeking a faster-paced environment, Jae-hyun transitioned to motorsport, drawn to the constant innovation and the pressure to deliver peak performance. 

At Meyer Shank Racing, Jae-hyun is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. He thrives on the challenge of creating custom components that push the boundaries of performance, and he's always seeking new ways to optimize designs and improve efficiency. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, making him a valued and respected member of the crew. He is known for his ability to reverse engineer problems and create unique solutions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Park is of average height with a wiry build, suggesting constant activity.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when concentrating.
Refuses to work on any component without first consulting detailed schematics, even if he's built it dozens of times before.
